items.root_cause: Two mechanisms. (a) build-sams-deals.ps1 Build-Row derives a size as list price / Sam's cent-rounded unit price whenever the name states its size in a unit family Sam's did not price by (a gallon jug priced '/oz'), so the size string is a FUNCTION OF THE PRICE with an error of 0.005/up (5.6% at $0.09), and pricing-math-lib's oz/floz interchange (Get-SizeAmount reads 'oz' as fl oz on a floz commodity) then divides by that quotient; basis-kind-allowlist keys its review on the size string, so every cent move in Sam's unit price re-keys the cell and re-fires the hard guard, and the 2026-08-08 review rationalised the quotient as a density conversion, which is the shape 'a reviewed exception that explains the wrong number'. (b) per-each bakery commodities cannot see piece size, so muffins enforces 'no minis' by the word mini, which brand names (Little Bites) and size-only names ('12 oz, 12 Count') evade; the commodity therefore prices 1.5 oz minis at three stores including the crown while its 0.40 band floor sat at 74% of that crown and did the mini/full-size job by accident; and the band-censorship ratchet counts CELLS whose classification is relative to a peer median, so a Baker's peer moving 0.9983 -> 0.625 promoted a rejection Brad had already retired into a 'new' censored cell with no new rejection and no new publish.
